message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. The background is a black, textured surface divided into a three-by-four grid by thin, golden-colored horizontal and vertical lines. Within these grid squares, various icons appear in a worn, brownish-tan color.

The icons include:
- Two open envelopes with rectangular slips inside.
- Two military-style helmets shown in profile.
- Two megaphones, each positioned next to a small human skull.
- Two military-style boots.
- A single unsheathed knife with a notched blade.

The central four squares are replaced by white text on the dark background that reads: "TEROR DI DETIK TERAKHIR" followed by a bulleted list: "● Politik Uang ● Intimidasi ● Pengerahan Aparat ● Kampanye Hitam". 

At the top, white text reads: "ALLAN NAIRN: IA AKAN JADI PRESIDEN BERBAHAYA" and "SULAP AUDIT KEUANGAN JAWA BARAT". A date "7-13 JULI 2014" is visible on the right. The bottom left contains "RP 35.000", website information, and a barcode. A red border runs along the left and bottom edges.
